judge.rationale: The agent correctly identifies Dev Okonkwo as the firmware owner who brought up the first Wayfare display and participated in the April field day that surfaced maintenance pain, and Noor Haddad as the renderer builder who also built the Ledgerline interface and started the Beacon Grid dashboard. Its additional cited details do not contradict the reference answer.
